scripts.clean: rimraf playwright-report allure-results blob-report test-results storage-states
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.validate:test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && playwright test
scripts.ui:prod: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=PROD playwright test --project=ui-chromium
scripts.ui:dev: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=DEV playwright test  --project=ui-chromium
scripts.api:prod: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=PROD playwright test --project=api
scripts.api:dev: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=DEV playwright test  --project=api
scripts.test:prod: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=PROD playwright test --project=ui-chromium --project=api
scripts.test:dev: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=DEV playwright test --project=ui-chromium --project=api
scripts.test:update-visual-snapshots: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=PROD playwright test --project=visual-chromium --update-snapshots
scripts.test:visual: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=PROD playwright test --project=visual-chromium
